risks.title: Loss of Key Employees
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its employees for success, and the loss of key employees could negatively impact relationships with customers and suppliers.

risks.title: Acquisition and Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: Acquisitions involve risks and uncertainties, including difficulty integrating acquired companies and unexpected costs, as illustrated by recent acquisitions of Resourcive and Advantix.

risks.title: IT System Failures
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its IT systems to manage its distribution operations, and a system failure could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Supply Chain Issues
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its suppliers (over 500 key suppliers) to obtain necessary products, and supply chain problems could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Customer Credit Exposure
risks.score_rationale: The company has credit exposure due to credit sales to approximately 25,000 sales partners, and credit losses could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Dependence on Third-Party Suppliers and Partners
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on over 500 key suppliers for its supplies, and a failure of these suppliers or partners could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Tariff and Macroeconomic Environment Risks
risks.score_rationale: The uncertain macroeconomic environment, including new tariffs announced by the United States and trade responses, creates significant uncertainty that may affect customers' technology spending.

risks.title: Inventory Value Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The value of the company's inventory could be affected by factors such as manufacturer price reductions or technological changes.

ai_positioning.summary: SCSC does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K report for fiscal year 2025. No strategic, technological, or operational references to AI are present in the Business, MD&A, or Risk Factors sections reviewed.
